Scene: An immense asymmetric threshold above a dawn mist ocean: two unequal folded ceramic wing walls hundreds of metres tall, dark mineral interior, real thick curved architecture and a broken bridge leading inside. Small weathered walking stones and rail remnants establish human scale. Camera begins low behind a near dark stone edge, slides clear in the first 1.5 seconds revealing the two soaring wings; at second 3 an extremely thin cyan seam awakens along their inner lip, then the walls slowly separate by a few metres to reveal warm sunlight and a still larger distant world. Camera moves along the diagonal bridge and gently rises, never hits the walls. Rich mineral erosion and structural ribs, narrow bright slit, fine airborne dust; hope mixed with awe. Not a flat sail, not two blank triangles.
